evidence: The ALD system uses ultrahigh-purity nitrogen as both the carrier gas and purge gas. The chamber is evacuated with an Alcatel 2021SD rotary vane pump; chamber pressure is controlled by simultaneously varying the conductance of the pump via a throttle valve and the flow rate of nitrogen. ALD is performed at a total pressure of 1 Torr with a total N2 flow rate of 78 sccm. The ALD deposition cycle used consisted of (i) TiCl4 pulse, (ii) N2 purge, (iii) H2O pulse, and (iv) N2 purge.
